dashboard.sampleQuestion: I have a stomachache after eating spicy food, what should I do?
dashboard.sampleAnswerIntro: Hi, a stomachache after eating spicy food can be a sign of inflammation or acid reflux. Spicy food contains capsaicin, which can irritate an already sensitive stomach lining.
dashboard.sampleAnswerStepsIntro: You should take the following steps to ease the discomfort:
dashboard.sampleStep1: Drink some cold milk or warm water to soothe your stomach.
dashboard.sampleStep2: Avoid lying down right after eating to prevent acid reflux.
dashboard.sampleStep3: Monitor the pain: if it is severe, accompanied by vomiting, or persists, seek medical care immediately.
dashboard.disclaimer: AI is for reference only and does not replace diagnosis or treatment by a specialist.
